job.title: [Post] Redesigning SAP Implementation for AI Efficiency

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] Redesigning SAP Implementation for AI Efficiency
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in your SAP implementation initiative. With over 5 years of professional experience building and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Platform
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services (headless APIs) for storefront and third-party consumers, and customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Data Integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Performance Tuning
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed; supported production troubleshooting and maintenance.

cover_en.gap: While I do not have direct hands-on experience specifically with AI-driven SAP efficiency features yet, I am very keen to learn and apply my strong Java and SAP Commerce background in this domain.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15/12/2026, making me available to start from 16/12/2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills match your team's needs.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise from Rockwell Automation and Shell to your enterprise environment. My background in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and system integrations aligns well with complex SAP implementations, and I am eager to contribute to your technical initiatives.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years in SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I offer deep expertise in Java, Spring, OCC APIs, and enterprise integrations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am currently based in Karlsruhe, serving notice until 15.12.2026, and available from 16.12.2026. I would love to connect regarding your SAP implementation role.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Implementation Role - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for your open SAP implementation role. With over 5 years of professional experience as an SAP Commerce Cloud Developer at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and enterprise data integrations.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit. I am serving my notice period until 15/12/2026 and will be available to start from 16/12/2026. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
